title: Framework Os Plugins And Wgpu Storybook Stories
description: Extend the framework/os Storybook scope: add plugins.stories.tsx (one story per PLUGIN_BUILD_TARGETS entry via OsBootHost) and Wgpu.stories.tsx (boots @semio-tech/framework-renderer-wgpu with a WebGPU-unavailable fallback), a WgpuBootHost helper in .storybook/framework/os/index.tsx, a dispose-callback fix to framework/renderer/wgpu/index.ts's bootFrameworkOsWgpu (which had a stale 3-arg call against the real 2-arg semioRendererBoot wasm-bindgen export), and .storybook/os-plugins.spec.ts (Playwright coverage of the plugin matrix boot outcomes). Part of the parallel workforce populating the composable root Storybook (parent ticket FEATURE-COMPLETE-COMPOSABLE-STORYBOOK-COVERING-THE-MONOREPO).
